Peanut Butter Cup Bars
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups Graham cracker crumbs
1 cup Peanut butter
1 cup Butter
3 1/2 cups Powdered sugar
3 teaspoons Butter
3 teaspoons Brown sugar
3 teaspoons Milk
1 cup Chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Combine graham cracker crumbs, peanut butter, 1 cup butter and powdered sugar. Work well with fingers and press into 9x13 pan. 2 Combine remaining butter, brown sugar and milk in small saucepan. 3 Boil for 1 minute. Add chocolate chips and stir until smooth. Spread on top of first mixture. Let cool, cut into squares.
